name: peco
description: Interactive filtering tool with fuzzy search for command-line text processing

tools.description: Interactive filtering tool for selecting items from lists with fuzzy matching and real-time search
tools.usage:
history | peco # Filter command history
ls | peco # Interactive file selection
ps aux | peco # Process selection
find . -name '*.txt' | peco # File finder with selection
peco --query 'initial search' # Start with pre-filled query
